outline.h2: What is a wedding photo app?
outline.answers: Core definition query; AI overview opens with how guests scan a QR code or tap a link to upload. Primary keyword.
h3: How guests add photos and videos
Guest photos and your photographer's gallery
outline.notes: No app names. Make clear guest photos sit alongside, not instead of, the professional photographer; link /expert-advice/average-cost-wedding-photographer.

outline.h2: The main types of wedding photo app
outline.answers: 'wedding photo sharing app', 'disposable camera app for wedding', 'qr code wedding photo sharing'; AI overview groups browser/QR galleries, dedicated apps and group albums, uploads to your own cloud drive.
h3: Shared album apps
QR code upload pages with no install
Disposable camera style apps
Live slideshow displays
Your photographer's own gallery
outline.notes: Types only, never brands (must_include list). What each suits and its trade-offs. No prices or storage limits.

outline.h2: Do guests need to download an app?
outline.answers: Recurring forum question in Melbourne and New York SERPs (Facebook 'I do not want them to have to download an app'); AI overview consensus point.
outline.notes: Older guests, international guests, roaming data.

outline.h2: What to look for before you choose
outline.answers: AI overview 'What to check' block: pricing model, storage and expiry, full-resolution originals, privacy and moderation. 'wedding photography app for guests'.
h3: No download needed for guests
Full resolution and video
Moderation and who can see the album
Downloading everything at the end
How long photos are kept
Offline uploads when signal is patchy
outline.notes: No figures. Phrase as checks for the couple.

outline.h2: Privacy, consent and who owns guest photos
outline.answers: Gap: no top-ranking page cites an official privacy or copyright source. Must-include per input notes.
h3: Asking guests before you share
Copyright in photos your guests take
outline.notes: Sharing images of people and children, asking before posting publicly, album visibility. outline.answers: 'wedding guest photo upload', 'how to post wedding photos' (Dubai PAA), 'how to collect wedding photos from guests'.

On the day: QR cards on tables and at the entrance
An unplugged ceremony, then uploads at the reception
After the wedding: download, back up and share
